To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed a new image restoration algorithm that incorporates the spatial information in teh image data and that we have demonstrated the effectiveness of our approach through a number of numerical experiments.
the MRL criterion is a natural and robust way of incorporating spatial information into the Bayesian image reconstruction problem.

1) the MRL statistic is a natural figure of merit for Bayesian image restoration which is consistent with the noise statistics of the data and which incorporates spatial information; 2) the MRL criterion can be used to produce robust and accurate image reconstructions; and 3) the MRL constraint alone is not sufficient to produce a restored image which is consistent with an image prior (e.g. an entropy constraint) unless the signal to noise ratio is sufficiently high.
